The following events took place in '''5,300 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] establishes a [[Jedi enclave (Mustafar)/Legends|training center]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*The [[Promised Land]] is completed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Battles==
*[[Battle of Yn]]<ref name="YnandChabosh">{{TORcite|type=codex|Force-walking}} establishes that [[Ergast]] attempted [[Tulak Hord's ritual]] 300 years after [[Tulak Hord]] himself. Additionally, {{TORcite|type=codex|Monument to Lord Ergast}} states that Ergast was among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who first permanently settled [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], which occurred in [[4980 BBY]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] per ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. Thus, Hord's use of the ritual, and by extension the battles of Yn and Chabosh, occurred roughly around 5300 BBY.</ref>
*[[Battle of Chabosh (Sith Empire)|Battle of Chabosh]]<ref name="YnandChabosh" />
